omitted: Duplicated S plan, source lists and full embedded packet metadata; immutable originals remain ignored
method: stdlib ZIP/NPY header and raw byte hashes only; no NumPy, project import, norm, operator, field restoration or sampling

excluded_numerical_controls: DtN rectangle and derived outgoing mode inventory

independent_A6_raw_vector_scope.method: same-pass original volume/incident/port action after actual entity/Floquet projection, with active interiors and raw plus solver-gauge modal lower rows retained
independent_A6_raw_vector_scope.norm_definition: Euclidean norm of the independently assembled trace residual, active-interior residual, and normalized modal-gauge rows; the original unnormalized modal rows are also retained separately

raw_full_active_scope.full_operator_norm_definition: sqrt(constraint-dual reduced-trace norm^2 + eliminated-interior Euclidean norm^2); do not take a plain concatenated Euclidean norm
raw_full_active_scope.method: same-pass exact block-Gaussian transformed residual; reduced trace/DtN residual is retained in its constraint-induced dual coordinates, while eliminated active-interior rows are retained in active-cell coordinates
raw_full_active_scope.trace_metric_action_definition: same-pass Gram inverse action for dual residual/RHS and Gram action for primal solution; vdot(trace, action) plus auxiliary Euclidean contribution reproduces each reduced norm squared
